description: This file defines the I18nController class which implements the ReactiveController interface to manage internationalization (i18n) subscription and update in a lit-based web component environment.

classes.name: I18nController
classes.description: A reactive controller for managing i18n subscription and updates in Lit web components.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the controller with a host and registers it.

methods.name: hostConnected
methods.description: Subscribes to i18n updates and requests host update on changes.

methods.name: hostDisconnected
methods.description: Unsubscribes from i18n updates to prevent memory leaks.
